description: This file implements a Bedrock-specific Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) ingestion class that manages AWS resources such as S3 buckets, OpenSearch Serverless collections, IAM roles, and Knowledge Bases for ingestion workflows. It supports auto-creation of resources or using existing ones, and handles uploading files to S3 and triggering ingestion jobs.

classes.name: BedrockRAGIngestion
classes.description: A class managing AWS resources and workflows for Bedrock Knowledge Base ingestion, supporting resource creation, file upload, and ingestion job management.

methods.name: _normalize_principal_arn
methods.description: Converts assumed-role ARNs to proper IAM role ARNs for data access policies.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the ingestion class, setting configuration parameters and AWS resource identifiers.

methods.name: _ensure_config_initialized
methods.description: Lazily initializes configuration by detecting existing resources or creating new ones.

methods.name: _auto_detect_config
methods.description: Auto-detects data source ID and S3 bucket from existing knowledge base.

methods.name: _create_knowledge_base_infrastructure
methods.description: Creates AWS resources including S3 bucket, OpenSearch collection, IAM role, and Knowledge Base.

methods.name: _create_s3_bucket
methods.description: Creates an S3 bucket for data storage.

methods.name: _create_opensearch_collection
methods.description: Creates an OpenSearch Serverless collection for vector storage.

methods.name: _create_opensearch_index
methods.description: Creates a vector index in OpenSearch with retry logic for propagation delays.

methods.name: _create_bedrock_role
methods.description: Creates an IAM role for Bedrock with necessary permissions.

methods.name: _create_knowledge_base
methods.description: Creates a Bedrock Knowledge Base linked to the collection and role.

methods.name: _create_data_source
methods.description: Creates a data source for the knowledge base.

methods.name: _get_boto3_client
methods.description: Returns a boto3 client for specified AWS service using credentials from BaseAWSLLM.

methods.name: embed
methods.description: Bedrock handles embedding internally; this method returns None.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Uploads a file to S3, triggers ingestion, and optionally waits for completion.
